svg.title: Home Run Apple wiring
svg.text: One Nano ESP32, powered from 12 V.
12 V, two wires, with its own end stops
red lead → OUT1 (nearest the heatsink), black lead → OUT2
Adafruit 254, on its own SPI bus
Optional: WS2812B LED sticks on A4; INA219 current sensor on the 12 V lead after the switch.
